entity.name: SceneView
entity.description: SceneView is a community-maintained open source project, started in 2021 as the successor of Google's discontinued Sceneform. It has no legal entity of its own: it is fiscally hosted by Open Source Collective, a US 501(c)(6) non-profit that holds the project's funds, signs agreements, issues invoices and publishes every incoming contribution and every expense on a public ledger. Funds pay for what the project consumes (build and test infrastructure, test devices, maintenance tooling, security work); when a maintainer has paid such a cost out of pocket, it is reimbursed against a receipt, and the reimbursement is on the public ledger like every other expense.

projects.name: SceneView
projects.description: Open source 3D and AR SDK for Android: Jetpack Compose components on Google Filament and ARCore, a Kotlin Multiplatform core (math, collision, geometry, physics) and a web viewer on Filament.js, plus an MCP server that lets AI coding assistants produce working 3D and AR code. Started in 2021 as the community successor of Google's discontinued Sceneform. Apache-2.0, published on Maven Central and npm. More than 1,300 stars on GitHub, and over 500 public repositories declare it as a dependency, among them the Meshtastic Android app, Block's open-source Bitkey wallet, WillowTree's Vocable AAC and the Niantic Spatial SDK samples; SDKs published by commercial vendors on Maven Central depend on it.

channels.description: Preferred channel. Fiscal host: Open Source Collective (US 501(c)(6)). Card, bank transfer, invoice and purchase order; grant agreements are signed by the fiscal host. Ledger is public.
Bank transfer against an invoice issued by Open Source Collective on behalf of the SceneView collective (reference: opencollective.com/sceneview).

plans.name: One year of maintenance and security hardening
plans.description: Covers one year of what the project consumes: release, build and device-test infrastructure; Android test devices across ARCore generations; maintenance tooling; a security pass on the code that parses untrusted 3D files (glTF/GLB, OBJ, STL, PLY, 3MF) before they reach native rendering code inside the apps that embed the SDK; and signed, provenance-attested releases on Maven Central and npm.

plans.name: Gold sponsor (3 places)
plans.description: For companies that ship SceneView. Funds the fixes, Filament upgrades and releases your product depends on; your company is listed nowhere unless you ask. Also 5,000 USD a year by invoice. Not a support contract: no private features, no early access, no priority on issues.
